metrics_definition.precision_recall: macro mean over classes with validation labels at IoU 0.50 and the selected confidence threshold
metrics_definition.dangerous_class_recall: macro mean recall over configs/danger_classes.yaml groups.critical
metrics_definition.critical_min_recall: minimum recall across the configured critical classes
metrics_definition.false_positives_per_image: unmatched detections divided by validation image count

yolov12n.selection_rule: maximum macro recall subject to macro precision >= 0.70; ties prefer precision then higher confidence

yolov26n.selection_rule: maximum macro recall subject to macro precision >= 0.70; ties prefer precision then higher confidence
